result.brief: 该文将均匀离散扩散语言模型刻画为联想记忆，用条件熵探测记忆到泛化的转变，与连续/潜空间语言建模仅有间接关联。
result.reason: Studies discrete diffusion language models as associative memories with memorization-generalization transition; only tangential link to continuous/latent language modeling, no visual or video representation contribution.
